studies.title: Your Efforts Run Apart
studies.meaning: Three oaths that are all pairs: night and day, one covering and one uncovering, and then the making of male and female. The claim they support is about divergence. Your strivings are scattered, going in different directions, which is the natural conclusion from a creation built out of opposites. Then the surah begins sorting, and the first of the two types is defined by three things, one of them giving.
studies.historicalContext: Meccan, and early. The surah goes on to describe two men in opposite directions, one who gives and one who withholds, and the classical sources connect the later ayat to particular individuals in Mecca, though the reports differ over who is meant. These opening lines carry no occasion. They set up the sorting with three pairs drawn from the sky and the body.

keyTerms.note: A verb for something spread over a thing until it is hidden, used of a cloth laid on a body. The night is described as an action rather than as an absence of light.
The particle can mean what or who, and scholars differ here. Most read it as naming the Creator, some as naming the act of creating itself, and the ambiguity is recorded rather than resolved.
A plural adjective for things going different ways, used of camels dispersing to graze. It says the directions differ rather than that some are better, and the sorting comes in the next line.

studies.lifeInProphetsTime: Herds went out at first light and scattered across the grazing, each animal taking its own line, and by evening they had to be gathered again. The word the surah uses for human efforts is the word for that scattering. A listener who had spent mornings watching a flock disperse across a valley would have had the picture before the argument arrived.
studies.didYouKnow: The two types described after this passage are given in matching shapes: three conditions each, then a promise built on the same verb. One is eased toward ease, the other eased toward hardship. The Quran uses the identical word for both, which means the same process is described running in two directions.
studies.theologicalSignificance: The oaths make difference structural. Night and day, male and female: creation is built out of opposed pairs, and human effort is placed in the same category. That normalises divergence before any judgement is passed, so the sorting that follows is not a complaint about variety but a claim that the directions lead somewhere different. The first type is then defined by an act, giving, rather than by a state of mind.

crossReferences.why: Completes the sorting this passage opens, giving three conditions for each type and a matched promise.
States the principle behind these oaths, that creation comes in pairs and the pairing is for thought.
Uses the same word for striving and attaches ownership to it rather than divergence.

studies.applyIt: Write down the three things you spent most of this week's energy on. Just the three, without ranking them. The ayah says efforts run in different directions, and most people have never actually looked at where theirs are pointing. Then leave the list somewhere you will see it on Friday.
